* '''Original''' ([[Ur'Ru'r (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. * '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “with "Tusken" in” to “with 'Tusken' in”, changed “phase, Ur'Ru'r” to “phase, may move Ur'Ru'r” and changed “Ur'Ru'r may make” to “Ur'Ru'r as”.<ref name="cl-1210_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
